sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: A few days ago, Daily producer Jessica Chung traveled to Iowa to meet with a farmer.
sentences.zh: 几天前，《每日》节目的制作人杰西卡·钟前往爱荷华州去见一位农民。

sentences.en: So this is from way up there where you see those poles to down there, there's a creek down there.
sentences.zh: 从你看到那些电线杆的高处一直到下面，那边有一条小溪。

sentences.en: This is all.
sentences.zh: 这全是。

sentences.en: This is all your field.
sentences.zh: 这全是你家的田地吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, one of my fields.
sentences.zh: 是的，是我的一块田。

sentences.en: It was a cornfield last year.
sentences.zh: 去年这里种的是玉米。

sentences.en: And then I will just go in and plant it in soybeans.
sentences.zh: 然后我就会进去种上大豆。

sentences.en: And it's amazing to look at this now and then come back in August and they'll be, if weather permitting, they'll be waist high.
sentences.zh: 现在看着这片土地，再等到八月份回来，如果天气允许的话，它们会长到腰那么高，这真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: And what will the crop look like?
sentences.zh: 那庄稼看起来会是什么样？

sentences.en: Green, leafy, you know, waves.
sentences.zh: 绿油油的，叶子茂密，你知道，像波浪一样。

sentences.en: Waves.
sentences.zh: 波浪。

sentences.en: Waves of green soybeans, yes.
sentences.zh: 绿色的豆浪，是的。

sentences.en: But for me here in Iowa, it's usually April is go time.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，在爱荷华州，通常四月就是行动的时候。

sentences.en: That's planting season.
sentences.zh: 那是播种季节。

sentences.en: So right now I want to get these soybeans in the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我想把这些大豆种进地里。

sentences.en: I want to plant and we want to plan.
sentences.zh: 我想播种，我们也想做计划。

sentences.en: The thing about the tariffs, it's hard to plan when they're out there looming.
sentences.zh: 关于关税的问题，当它们隐约出现时，很难进行规划。

sentences.en: You know, what's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 你知道，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日》节目。

sentences.en: In the increasingly bitter trade war between the United States and China, perhaps nobody has more at stake than America's soybean farmers,
sentences.zh: 在美中之间日益激烈的贸易战中，或许没有人比美国的豆农面临更大的风险，

sentences.en: whose crop has become the country's single biggest export to China.
sentences.zh: 他们的作物已经成为美国对华出口的最大单一产品。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with an Iowa farmer who helped build the $13 billion market for U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，我采访了一位爱荷华州的农民，她曾帮助建立起美国对华130亿美元的大豆市场，

sentences.en: soybeans in China about what the sky-high tariffs instigated by President Trump now means for her and tens of thousands of American farmers.
sentences.zh: 谈谈特朗普总统发起的超高关税现在对她和成千上万的美国农民意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月24日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hi, April.
sentences.zh: 嗨，艾普丽尔。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: So, you're sitting in a closet?
sentences.zh: 所以，你现在坐在壁橱里？

sentences.en: I'm standing in a closet.
sentences.zh: 我正站在壁橱里。

sentences.en: Wow, that's all you can afford up there at the New York Times, huh?
sentences.zh: 哇，这就是《纽约时报》能提供的全部条件了，是吗？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: I decided to do this from home.
sentences.zh: 我决定在家做这个。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Speaking of backgrounds, are you in your kitchen?
sentences.zh: 说到背景，你在厨房里吗？

sentences.en: I'm, yes.
sentences.zh: 我，是的。

sentences.en: What is that stuff on the wall behind you?
sentences.zh: 你身后墙上那些东西是什么？

sentences.en: So, it's pictures of where I've been and some of my personal travels and soybean travels, so...
sentences.zh: 哦，那是我去过的地方的照片，还有我的一些个人旅行和大豆考察的记录，所以……

sentences.en: And anything from China on those walls?
sentences.zh: 墙上有什么关于中国的东西吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: Yeah, the Terracotta Soldiers and the Forbidden City is over there.
sentences.zh: 是的，兵马俑和紫禁城就在那边。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Lots of good stuff.
sentences.zh: 有很多好东西。

sentences.en: Well, are you feeling ready for this conversation?
sentences.zh: 那么，你准备好开始这次谈话了吗？

sentences.en: Let's rock and roll.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Can I just start, for the benefit of our listeners, by asking you to tell us your name, with your permission, your age, and what you do on the farm?
sentences.zh: 为了听众着想，我能先请你介绍一下你的名字、年龄，以及你在农场的工作吗？

sentences.en: So, I'm April Hemis.
sentences.zh: 我是艾普丽尔·赫米斯。

sentences.en: I am a 65-year-old farmer.
sentences.zh: 我是一位65岁的农民。

sentences.en: I'm here on my family's century farm.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在我家族的百年农场里。

sentences.en: My great-grandfather purchased it in 1901.
sentences.zh: 我曾祖父在1901年买下了它。

sentences.en: I raise soybeans and corn on my farm in Iowa, and the best soil in the world.
sentences.zh: 我在爱荷华州的农场里种植大豆和玉米，这里有世界上最好的土壤。

sentences.en: And I've been on a lot of different boards through the years, United Soybean Board and the Iowa Soybean Board.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我参加过许多不同的委员会，比如美国大豆协会和爱荷华州大豆协会。

sentences.en: So, part of my travels to China were promoting soybeans.
sentences.zh: 所以，我去中国的部分行程就是为了推广大豆。

sentences.en: And how much of your crop ends up being shipped to China right now?
sentences.zh: 目前你种植的作物有多少最终被运往中国？

sentences.en: About 53%.
Over half of the soybeans exported in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国出口的大豆中超过一半

sentences.en: go to China.
sentences.zh: 都销往中国。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that's huge.
sentences.zh: 那可是个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: You know, the American farmers, we're very good at what we do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国农民，我们非常擅长我们的工作。

sentences.en: We raise very high-quality crops.
sentences.zh: 我们种植高质量的作物。

sentences.en: And so, we're so good, we don't use it all here domestically.
sentences.zh: 我们太擅长了，以至于国内用不完。

sentences.en: We have a great domestic market, but we need to export it.
sentences.zh: 我们有很好的国内市场，但我们需要出口。

sentences.en: So, China imports our whole soybean, and they crush it there, because that's the value is crushing that soybean, we call it.
sentences.zh: 所以，中国进口我们的整粒大豆，然后在那里进行压榨，因为我们称之为压榨的价值所在。

sentences.en: And then, like, 80% is the meal, and around 20% is the oil.
sentences.zh: 大约80%是豆粕，20%左右是豆油。

sentences.en: And the meal goes to feed all their livestock.
sentences.zh: 豆粕用来喂养他们所有的牲畜。

sentences.en: And I think they're the largest pork producers in the planet.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是全球最大的猪肉生产国。

sentences.en: They raise the most pork.
sentences.zh: 他们养的猪最多。

sentences.en: So, a lot of our soybeans get fed to their pork, and ducks, and chickens, poultry.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们的大量大豆被用来喂养他们的猪、鸭、鸡和家禽。

sentences.en: And then the oil, all the oil gets used for human use, for frying.
sentences.zh: 至于豆油，所有的油都用于人类消费，用于煎炸。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: The reason we wanted to talk to you about all of this is because you, April,
sentences.zh: 我们想和你谈谈这一切的原因是，艾普丽尔，

sentences.en: occupy a really interesting and kind of pivotal place in the story of how that relationship between Iowa farmers and China came to be.
sentences.zh: 你在爱荷华州农民与中国之间关系形成的故事中，占据了一个非常有趣且关键的位置。

sentences.en: And we want you to tell that story.
sentences.zh: 我们想请你讲讲那个故事。

sentences.en: And I think that it would be helpful to begin with the past, basically what the world looked like before farmers like you and those around you sent so much of your crop to China.
sentences.zh: 我想从过去开始讲起会很有帮助，基本上就是看看在像你这样的农民和周围的人向中国出口这么多作物之前，世界是什么样子的。

sentences.en: So, can we start by having you paint a picture for us of what it was like in the before?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们能先请你为我们描绘一下“过去”是什么样子的吗？

sentences.en: I don't know where you would start that, but I'm going to guess it's a few decades ago.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该从哪里开始，但我猜那是几十年前的事了。

sentences.en: So, I came home in 1985.
sentences.zh: 我是在1985年回家的。

sentences.en: This is actually my 40th year at home on the farm, which is quite amazing to me.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我在农场工作的第40个年头，这对我来说非常了不起。

sentences.en: So, I graduated in animal science from Iowa State University, and then I worked at the Iowa Swain Testing Station for a little while, and then I got a phone call.
sentences.zh: 我从爱荷华州立大学动物科学专业毕业，然后在爱荷华州猪肉测试站工作了一段时间，接着我接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: We need somebody to talk, Iowan, in Washington, D.C., greeting people to a brand new elected congressman.
sentences.zh: 我们需要有人在华盛顿特区用爱荷华口音迎接一位新当选的国会议员。

sentences.en: And I learned pretty quickly that's not where I wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 我很快就意识到那不是我想待的地方。

sentences.en: My goal all along was to come back to the farm.
sentences.zh: 我一直以来的目标就是回到农场。

sentences.en: I kind of made that decision and called home, and I said, I want to come back to the farm.
sentences.zh: 我做出了那个决定，给家里打了电话，我说，我想回农场。

sentences.en: And my dad said, no, you're not coming back to the farm.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说，不，你不能回农场。

sentences.en: This is terrible timing.
sentences.zh: 现在时机太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And my grandfather was the one who said, if she wants to come back and farm, she's coming back.
sentences.zh: 是我祖父说，如果她想回来务农，她就回来。

sentences.en: Well, what about the timing was terrible?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么说时机很糟糕呢？

sentences.en: So, it was the farm crisis.
sentences.zh: 因为当时正值农业危机。

sentences.en: So, everything just fell apart.
sentences.zh: 一切都崩溃了。

sentences.en: We had huge interest rates.
sentences.zh: 我们的利率高得惊人。

sentences.en: So, it was like 16% intereSt.
sentences.zh: 利率高达16%。

sentences.en: And then the land, the price of the land was going up.
sentences.zh: 而且土地价格还在上涨。

sentences.en: So, some people bought land very high priced with very high interest rates, and then our commodity prices were not good.
sentences.zh: 有些人以极高的价格和极高的利率买了地，然后我们的商品价格却不好。

sentences.en: And then, once farmers started failing, the banks started failing.
sentences.zh: 一旦农民开始破产，银行也开始倒闭。

sentences.en: So, we had a lot of agriculture banks go out of business.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多农业银行倒闭了。

sentences.en: And it was a time of white crosses in the courtyard when they had to go sell farms and people selling off their, you know, possessions to make bank payments, things like that.
sentences.zh: 那是一个法院里竖起白十字架的时期，他们不得不去拍卖农场，人们变卖财产来偿还银行贷款，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Am I right, April, in remembering from some civics book I read many, many years ago that a factor in the farm crisis was that there was simply too much crop?
sentences.zh: 艾普丽尔，我从多年前读过的公民课本里记得，农业危机的一个因素是作物产量过剩，我对吗？

sentences.en: We did have overproduction.
sentences.zh: 我们确实产量过剩了。

sentences.en: We just had too much.
sentences.zh: 我们就是产得太多了。

sentences.en: We weren't trading around the world and exporting like we are now.
sentences.zh: 我们当时不像现在这样在世界各地进行贸易和出口。

sentences.en: And so, that's really late 80s, early 90s is when that focus to export, especially to China, really ramped up.
sentences.zh: 所以，直到80年代末、90年代初，出口（尤其是对华出口）的重心才真正加强。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why was that market seen as a potential answer to the farm crisis?
sentences.zh: 为什么那个市场被视为解决农业危机的潜在答案？

sentences.en: Well, because they had such a growing population then, and we knew we had extra we had to export to.
sentences.zh: 因为那时他们的人口增长非常快，我们知道我们有多余的产量需要出口。

sentences.en: But you have to develop these things, and it takes a long time to develop relationships and truSt.
sentences.zh: 但你必须开发这些市场，建立关系和信任需要很长时间。

sentences.en: And that all started, it actually started with President Nixon going there in the 70s, and you just start building that truSt.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于尼克松总统在70年代访问中国，你就是从那时开始建立信任的。

sentences.en: And then, they started importing in the 90s from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们在90年代开始从美国进口大豆。

sentences.en: soybeans.
sentences.zh: 大豆。

sentences.en: You just hinted at how this is a relationship that needs to be worked on.
sentences.zh: 你刚才暗示了这种关系需要经营。

sentences.en: It doesn't happen on its own.
sentences.zh: 它不会自动发生。

sentences.en: So, how do you, April, go from being a farmer who may be benefiting from this new Chinese market
sentences.zh: 那么，艾普丽尔，你是如何从一个可能受益于这个新中国市场的农民，

sentences.en: to somebody personally involved in working on and even expanding the relationship between farmers in places like Iowa and China?
sentences.zh: 变成一个亲自参与经营甚至扩大爱荷华州等地农民与中国之间关系的人的呢？

sentences.en: How does that happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, it happens on getting involved in your local boards or state boards or, in my case, national boards.
sentences.zh: 这始于参与当地委员会、州委员会，或者像我这样参与国家委员会。

sentences.en: So, you know, let's zoom through the 90s into the 2000s.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们快速回顾一下90年代到2000年代。

sentences.en: And through the Iowa Farm Bureau, I got to visit China for the first time on a market study tour.
sentences.zh: 通过爱荷华州农业局，我第一次以市场考察团的身份访问了中国。

sentences.en: And it was a bunch of Iowa farmers, and what first struck us on our bus rides was the agriculture, of course, because we're farmers.
sentences.zh: 那是一群爱荷华州的农民，我们坐在巴士上，首先吸引我们注意的当然是农业，因为我们是农民。

sentences.en: And it's not just big, huge fields like we're used to here.
sentences.zh: 那里的田地不像我们这里那样是大片大片的。

sentences.en: It was very, very small parcels put together.
sentences.zh: 而是由非常非常小的地块拼凑在一起的。

sentences.en: So, that's how they got to lease the ground from the government.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们从政府那里租赁土地的方式。

sentences.en: So, it's all hand done.
sentences.zh: 所以一切都是手工完成的。

sentences.en: We saw the stover from the corn piled in the corner.
sentences.zh: 我们看到玉米秸秆堆在角落里。

sentences.en: The stover is the corn stalks, anything but the corn.
sentences.zh: 秸秆就是玉米秆，除了玉米以外的所有部分。

sentences.en: And they would use that to heat their houses.
sentences.zh: 他们会用它来取暖。

sentences.en: You know, they were drying their wheat on the road.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们还在马路上晾晒小麦。

sentences.en: They had spread the wheat out on the road to dry it.
sentences.zh: 他们把小麦铺在路上晾晒。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: You're noticing some real limitations in how China farMs.
sentences.zh: 你注意到了中国农业的一些局限性。

sentences.en: Yes, and one of the biggest ones, they took us to one of their show farMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中最大的局限之一，他们带我们参观了他们的示范农场。

sentences.en: And the interpreters always wanted to be by me and talk to me.
sentences.zh: 翻译总是想待在我身边跟我说话。

sentences.en: And so, they said...
sentences.zh: 于是，他们说……

sentences.en: I can't imagine why.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象为什么。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: April, is this just like your farm?
sentences.zh: 艾普丽尔，这和你农场一样吗？

sentences.en: Now, it's the same size as my farm, a thousand-acre farm.
sentences.zh: 现在，它和我农场的规模一样，都是一千英亩的农场。

sentences.en: There were like 400 landowners, let's say.
sentences.zh: 大概有400个土地所有者吧，我们就这么说。

sentences.en: They didn't own it.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有真正拥有它。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the Chinese are very good at showing you what they want you to see.
sentences.zh: 而且中国人非常擅长向你展示他们想让你看到的东西。

sentences.en: There were like 24 row combines lined up, little tiny tractors, you know, a bunch of those.
sentences.zh: 当时大概有24台联合收割机排成一排，还有些小拖拉机，你知道的，一大堆那种。

sentences.en: And the interpreter said, April, is this like your tractor?
sentences.zh: 翻译问我：艾普丽尔，这和你用的拖拉机一样吗？

sentences.en: And I said, I don't mean to be disrespectful, but that is like the tractor I mow my lawn with.
sentences.zh: 我说：我无意冒犯，但这和我割草用的拖拉机差不多。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it's like, I said, no, what you're doing on this farm, I do by myself.
sentences.zh: 我说：不，你们在这个农场里做的这些事，我一个人就能干完。

sentences.en: So, what happens after that initial market tour trip?
sentences.zh: 那么，那次最初的市场考察之旅后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, I was really glad I went on that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很庆幸自己去了那一趟。

sentences.en: I assumed it was going to be the last time I, or only time I ever got there.
sentences.zh: 我本以为那是我最后一次，或者唯一一次去那里。

sentences.en: But then, fast forward to 2015, and I was appointed to the United Soybean Board by the Secretary of Ag.
sentences.zh: 但快进到2015年，我被农业部长任命为美国大豆协会的成员。

sentences.en: And so, I was asked to go on a trip there to support soybeans.
sentences.zh: 于是，我受邀去那里支持大豆贸易。

sentences.en: And that's where I met Honorable Mr. President Bien.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那里，我见到了尊敬的卞主席。

sentences.en: And if you ever go to China, I hope you guys have a chance to, and you meet public officials.
sentences.zh: 如果你去中国，我希望你们也有机会见到政府官员。

sentences.en: It's these huge rooms with the large murals in the background.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的房间，背景挂着大幅壁画。

sentences.en: And you're just in awe.
sentences.zh: 你会感到肃然起敬。

sentences.en: And it's meant to be that way, I think, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想，这正是他们想要的效果。

sentences.en: So, I met with him, very cordial.
sentences.zh: 我和他见了面，非常亲切。

sentences.en: And he...
sentences.zh: 而且他……

sentences.en: And just for those who may not understand, what is his role in the Chinese economy and government?
sentences.zh: 对于那些可能不了解的人，他在中国经济和政府中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Yeah, he was the president of the Commerce Department for Food and Natural Agriculture Products.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是负责食品和天然农产品的商务部部长。

sentences.en: So, it's who we talked to when we went over there, because he was kind of the head of that commerce department.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们去那边时就是和他对接，因为他算是那个商务部门的负责人。

sentences.en: Guys, so you're kind of talking to the big cheese when it comes to soybeans.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，所以你们在谈论大豆时，是在和真正的大人物对话。

sentences.en: He was the dude, yes.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个关键人物，没错。

sentences.en: He was the man.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个人。

sentences.en: So, you know, we meet, and you go into this big room.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们见面了，走进那个大房间。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not a negotiator for the government or anything.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是政府的谈判代表什么的。

sentences.en: I was there to tell my story, talk about the high-quality soybeans.
sentences.zh: 我去那里是为了讲述我的故事，谈谈高质量的大豆。

sentences.en: I just told him how I raised my crops.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉他我是如何种植作物的。

sentences.en: You know, this is how I, you know, I plant my soybeans.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是我种植大豆的方式。

sentences.en: I keep my water quality high.
sentences.zh: 我保持着高质量的水质。

sentences.en: How I harvested them, weed-free.
sentences.zh: 我是如何收获它们的，确保没有杂草。

sentences.en: And then afterwards, there's usually a supper or a dinner, and literally the big spinny table where you get to pick what you eat.
sentences.zh: 之后通常会有晚宴，就是那种你可以挑选食物的大圆桌。

sentences.en: The whole fish presented, or the whole duck, the Peking duck with the head on it and everything, you know.
sentences.zh: 整条鱼，或者整只鸭子，带着头的北京烤鸭等等，你知道的。

sentences.en: And then they come out and serve you.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会出来为你上菜。

sentences.en: It's really, it's quite grand when you have a state meal.
sentences.zh: 国宴确实非常隆重。

sentences.en: But then they bring the soju out, and it's rocket fuel, basically.
sentences.zh: 但后来他们拿出了烧酒，那基本上就是火箭燃料。

sentences.en: That's alcohol.
sentences.zh: 那是酒精。

sentences.en: And then you do toaSt.
sentences.zh: 然后你们开始敬酒。

sentences.en: And so, you know, you go around, and the person that's hosting goes around to every single person and does a toast to them.
sentences.zh: 主人会走到每个人面前，向他们敬酒。

sentences.en: And you say gumbay, which means bottoms up, and then down it.
sentences.zh: 你会说“干杯”，意思是一饮而尽，然后喝下去。

sentences.en: And the higher the official, the better the booze, as we say.
sentences.zh: 俗话说，官员级别越高，酒就越好。

sentences.en: But they're not telling you.
sentences.zh: 但他们不会告诉你。

sentences.en: So in this burgeoning kind of personal set of relationships between you and the Chinese government and their economic community, do they end up sending their folks over to you?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你与中国政府及其经济界之间这种日益增长的个人关系中，他们最终会派人来找你吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so the United Soybean Export Council used to bring soybean buyers from China and take a tour in the fall
sentences.zh: 是的，美国大豆出口协会过去常在秋季带中国的买家来参观，

sentences.en: and bring them to the farm so they can see what kind of a crop we're going to have.
sentences.zh: 带他们到农场看看我们会有什么样的收成。

sentences.en: Is it going to be a good crop?
sentences.zh: 收成会好吗？

sentences.en: You know, are they going to have plenty of beans?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会有足够的大豆吗？

sentences.en: And in the fall, in Iowa, we host the World Food Prize here.
sentences.zh: 秋天的时候，我们在爱荷华州举办世界粮食奖。

sentences.en: And that's when Honorable Mr. President Bien came.
sentences.zh: 那就是尊敬的卞主席来的时候。

sentences.en: Oh, wait, that same official came to Iowa.
sentences.zh: 等等，那位官员亲自来了爱荷华州？

sentences.en: Yes, and he came to my farm.
sentences.zh: 是的，他还去了我的农场。

sentences.en: I knew they were going to stop by.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们会顺道过来。

sentences.en: I didn't know it was going to be him.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道会是他本人。

sentences.en: And so I was combining corn.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在收割玉米。

sentences.en: So I said, let's go, hop in the combine.
sentences.zh: 我说：走吧，跳上收割机。

sentences.en: And I go, okay, and I showed him, because it's auto steer.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，因为这是自动驾驶的。

sentences.en: So you push a button and it steers itself.
sentences.zh: 你按个按钮，它就能自动行驶。

sentences.en: But he wanted to steer that thing.
sentences.zh: 但他想亲自开那玩意儿。

sentences.en: So he was driving over my 240 bushel corn.
sentences.zh: 于是他开着车压过了我的240蒲式耳玉米地。

sentences.en: I was getting a little upset with him, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我当时有点生他的气。

sentences.en: Is he sort of destroying your corn?
sentences.zh: 他是在毁坏你的玉米吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, he was, yeah, he was driving over my corn.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实在压坏我的玉米。

sentences.en: So he got back.
sentences.zh: 所以他退了回来。

sentences.en: We got him back on the row.
sentences.zh: 我们让他回到了行进路线上。

sentences.en: And he was going.
sentences.zh: 他继续开着。

sentences.en: And I was explaining how the combine works.
sentences.zh: 我向他解释收割机是如何工作的。

sentences.en: It takes the corn off the cob.
sentences.zh: 它把玉米从芯上剥下来。

sentences.en: And then I said, turn around.
sentences.zh: 然后我说：转过身来。

sentences.en: And that's where the corn goes.
sentences.zh: 玉米就是从那里进去的。

sentences.en: And he turned around, you know, and the corn's all going in the tank, in the combine.
sentences.zh: 他转过身，你知道，玉米全都进了收割机的粮箱里。

sentences.en: And he's just, his eyes were huge.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛瞪得大大的。

sentences.en: And he just kept saying, how satisfying.
sentences.zh: 他不停地说：太令人满足了。

sentences.en: How satisfying.
sentences.zh: 太令人满足了。

sentences.en: I said, yeah, but not when you do it nine, ten hours a day, you know.
sentences.zh: 我说：是啊，但如果你每天干九到十个小时，就不会这么觉得了。

sentences.en: But just the amazement of being in there.
sentences.zh: 但那种身临其境的惊叹感是真实的。

sentences.en: And I also knew he would walk away with that, you know, driving this big, huge combine in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我也知道他离开时会记住这一点，你知道，在美国开着这台巨大的收割机。

sentences.en: And just being able to have that experience, I would think is pretty important.
sentences.zh: 能有这样的体验，我认为非常重要。

sentences.en: Tell me in your mind why this kind of interaction matters.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，在你看来，这种互动为什么重要？

sentences.en: You talking to this Chinese economic official, this Chinese economic official talking to you.
sentences.zh: 你与这位中国经济官员交谈，这位中国经济官员与你交谈。

sentences.en: Like, fundamentally, what is the value of this?
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，这有什么价值？

sentences.en: I think the value is that personal connection.
sentences.zh: 我认为价值在于那种个人联系。

sentences.en: The personal relationship.
sentences.zh: 那种个人关系。

sentences.en: Because it doesn't, you, I mean, it does come down to price.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，价格确实很重要。

sentences.en: But when we can tell our stories and they have a face to put with that farmer, you know, they can go, oh, soybean farmer, April, yeah.
sentences.zh: 但当我们能讲述自己的故事，而他们能把这位农民与具体的面孔联系起来时，他们就会说：哦，大豆农艾普丽尔，是的。

sentences.en: I know her.
sentences.zh: 我认识她。

sentences.en: I've talked to her.
sentences.zh: 我和她谈过。

sentences.en: I know how she raises her crop.
sentences.zh: 我知道她是如何种植作物的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I've been to her farm.
sentences.zh: 我去过她的农场。

sentences.en: You know, things like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And that personal connection goes a long way, you know.
sentences.zh: 那种个人联系意义深远。

sentences.en: Am I saying it goes a lot farther than cheaper soybeans?
sentences.zh: 我是说它比便宜的大豆更重要吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: But when it comes to.
sentences.zh: 但当谈到……

sentences.en: It's a factor.
sentences.zh: 这是一个因素。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it's amazing to me how much of a factor it can be.
sentences.zh: 它能成为多大的一个因素，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And it does mean something now because they have other places they can go.
sentences.zh: 这确实很有意义，因为他们现在有其他选择。

sentences.en: And yet they still buy over half of our soybeans we export.
sentences.zh: 然而他们仍然购买了我们出口的一半以上的大豆。

sentences.en: Overall, how many times do you end up going to China?
sentences.zh: 总的来说，你最终去了中国多少次？

sentences.en: Eight or nine times, at least nine times, I think.
sentences.zh: 八九次，我想至少九次。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: During this period, as you're making all these trips and as these relationships are clearly growing, how much is the actual trade relationship growing between Iowa farmers,
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，随着你不断往返，这些关系明显在增长，爱荷华州农民，

sentences.en: soybean farmers especially, and China?
sentences.zh: 特别是大豆农，与中国之间的实际贸易关系增长了多少？

sentences.en: Like if there's a graph, a chart that shows what's happening during this period.
sentences.zh: 如果有一张图表能显示这段时间发生了什么。

sentences.en: Oh, that chart's a beauty in 2016 or 2017.
sentences.zh: 哦，那张图表在2016年或2017年时非常漂亮。

sentences.en: Because it was growing, growing, growing.
sentences.zh: 因为它一直在增长，增长，增长。

sentences.en: And then the first tariffs hit.
sentences.zh: 然后第一轮关税来了。

sentences.en: And then boom.
sentences.zh: 然后砰的一声。

sentences.en: Down.
sentences.zh: 跌落了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Let's talk about today.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈今天的情况。

sentences.en: After spending all these years cultivating the relationships that you have so successfully cultivated and that has been beneficial to both sides.
sentences.zh: 在花费多年时间培养了如此成功且对双方都有益的关系之后，

sentences.en: China getting the soybeans, farmers like you selling so much to China.
sentences.zh: 中国获得了大豆，像你这样的农民向中国出售了大量产品。

sentences.en: I want to know what it's been like to watch over the past few weeks as these historically high tariffs go into place.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，过去几周看着这些历史性的高关税生效是什么感觉。

sentences.en: First, by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 首先是美国，

sentences.en: and reaching up to, I think, 145%.
sentences.zh: 关税高达145%。

sentences.en: Then China retaliates.
sentences.zh: 然后中国进行报复。

sentences.en: Theirs go up to 125%, which directly, directly impacts you.
sentences.zh: 他们的关税提高到125%，这直接、直接地影响了你。

sentences.en: So, what is the state of the relationship right now between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，目前美国和——

sentences.en: and— You mean today?
sentences.zh: 你是说今天吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，就在现在。

sentences.en: What is the state of the trade relationship?
sentences.zh: 贸易关系的现状如何？

sentences.en: Well, you called Donald Trump up and you called the president up and ask him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你给唐纳德·特朗普打了电话，给总统打了电话，去问他吧。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我很抱歉。

sentences.en: I wasn't going to get political.
sentences.zh: 我本来不想谈政治的。

sentences.en: Well, since you raised it, did you vote for this?
sentences.zh: 既然你提到了，你投了票支持这个吗？

sentences.en: I knew it was coming.
sentences.zh: 我知道这会来。

sentences.en: Here it was.
sentences.zh: 它就在这儿。

sentences.en: I never answer that question.
sentences.zh: 我从不回答那个问题。

sentences.en: It's private.
sentences.zh: 这是私事。

sentences.en: I have been asked that question every single time I'm interviewed.
sentences.zh: 每次接受采访时，我都会被问到这个问题。

sentences.en: And my answer is, it doesn't matter who I voted for.
sentences.zh: 我的回答是，我投给谁并不重要。

sentences.en: We have them for a president.
sentences.zh: 我们现在有了一位总统。

sentences.en: And farmers tend not to look back.
sentences.zh: 农民通常不喜欢回头看。

sentences.en: We like to look forward, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢向前看，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I just wish the instability of everything right now is probably what bothers me more than anything.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，眼下这种一切都不稳定的状态，恐怕是我最烦心的事情。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: I worry about the—what's the weather going to do?
sentences.zh: 我担心的是——天气会怎么样？

sentences.en: What are the markets going to do?
sentences.zh: 市场会怎么样？

sentences.en: What's going to do next for tariffs?
sentences.zh: 关税接下来会怎么样？

sentences.en: But we need, especially in agriculture, quite honestly, in any industry, in order to plan, we need some kind of stability.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要，特别是在农业领域，老实说，在任何行业，为了制定计划，我们都需要某种稳定性。

sentences.en: And this is not stability.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是稳定性。

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是。

sentences.en: And not just in agriculture, but in the bond market, in the stock market, everywhere.
sentences.zh: 不仅是在农业领域，在债券市场、股票市场，到处都是这样。

sentences.en: So it's hard for businesses such as farming or any other business to plan when we don't know if we're going to have a market to go to, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，当不知道是否还有市场可去时，像农业或其他任何企业都很难制定计划，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I think, I hope—let me put it this way.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我希望——让我这么说吧。

sentences.en: I hope at the end of the day, they get together sooner rather than later.
sentences.zh: 我希望最终他们能尽早坐下来谈谈。

sentences.en: And whether it's Xi and Trump or whoever, they get together and figure something out and say, let's start working on this.
sentences.zh: 无论是习近平和特朗普，还是其他人，他们能坐下来商量出个结果，说，让我们开始着手解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Because not doing anything isn't helping anyone.
sentences.zh: 因为什么都不做对谁都没有帮助。

sentences.en: I'm curious if, since this all began over the past month or so, if you've been in touch with any of your contacts over in China, that secretary, for instance.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，自从过去一个月左右这一切开始以来，你是否与你在中国的一些联系人保持过联系，比如那位秘书？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, he retired several years ago.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，他几年前就退休了。

sentences.en: So I don't get to see Honorable Mr. President Bien anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以我再也见不到尊敬的Bien先生了。

sentences.en: And I haven't—I have seen a couple buyers that live in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 而且我没有——我见过几个住在爱荷华州的买家。

sentences.en: You've seen some Chinese buyers in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 你在爱荷华州见过一些中国买家。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, because they live in Iowa or at different events and things like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，因为他们住在爱荷华州，或者在不同的活动上等等。

sentences.en: And what do they say?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么说？

sentences.en: You know, they're the same way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们也是一样的想法。

sentences.en: You know, they live—they just want—they want that market there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们生活——他们只是想要——他们想要那个市场在那里。

sentences.en: They want to not worry about the unknown, you know.
sentences.zh: 他们不想担心未知的情况，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I think we all expected tariffs to come back, but not to the extent that they have been.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都预料到关税会卷土重来，但没想到会达到现在的程度。

sentences.en: And just in the past, I know the Chinese will dig in their heels.
sentences.zh: 而且在过去，我知道中国人会坚持立场。

sentences.en: And I don't—I wonder how long the American public will dig in theirs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道——我想知道美国公众会坚持多久。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about the American soybean farmer, you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们谈谈美国大豆农民，也就是你。

sentences.en: I mean, and whether you dig in and how you dig in.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你是否坚持，以及你如何坚持。

sentences.en: I mean, what would it mean for you for tariffs on the scale that are in place and the retaliatory tariffs that are in place?
sentences.zh: 我是说，对于目前实施的关税规模以及已经实施的报复性关税，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: What would it mean for you for those to remain in place for any meaningful stretch of time?
sentences.zh: 如果这些关税在任何有意义的时间段内持续存在，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: Quite honestly, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Other farmers I've talked to are a wait and see.
